puzzles.title: Anastasia's Mate
puzzles.description: White to move. Sacrifice the queen on h7 to open the h-file, then deliver Anastasia's checkmate with the knight and rook!

puzzles.title: Morphy's Opera Game Mate
puzzles.description: Paul Morphy vs Duke of Brunswick (Paris 1858). White to move and finish the legendary game with a queen sacrifice and rook mate!

puzzles.title: Smothered Mate (Philidor's Legacy)
puzzles.description: White to move. Force Black's king to h8, sacrifice the queen on g8, and deliver the smothered mate with Nf7#!

puzzles.title: Back-Rank Decoy Mate
puzzles.description: White to move. Capitalize on Black's trapped king on the 8th rank to deliver an immediate back-rank mate.

puzzles.title: Rook Fork & Active Defense
puzzles.description: Black king is in check from the white rook. Find the most active central square to stay safe.

puzzles.title: Pawn Breakthrough & King Opposition
puzzles.description: White to move. Push the passed pawn forward with check to challenge Black's defense.
